hypothesis: Allowing an independently admitted focused CEM proposal to fill more predicted relative ESS before switching to plain MC improves the complete matrix
design: Focused CEM discovery, independent validation, frozen fresh production. Only the allocation utility target changed from relative ESS 10 to 50; the reported coverage score retained its cap at 10.
reason: Extra targeted production in two runs yielded no new ESS>=10 cells, reduced ESS>=25 coverage, and did not close the equal-work plain MC gap. A 20-seed confirmation was not warranted.
